resources.string: The same ledger on all your devices, end-to-end encrypted

Devices signed in to the same account keep the same ledger. Records are encrypted on this device with your sync passphrase before they are uploaded, so only your devices can read them. Attachments, merchant icons, settings, AI keys and brokerage connections are not uploaded.
The F-Droid build contains no Google services. To sync, install the standard build. You can still move data with a backup file under Backup & Sync.
This device stops syncing. Its data stays here, and the cloud copy stays in your account.
Your other devices ask for it when they turn on sync. The passphrase itself is never uploaded.
Use the passphrase you set on your other device.
If you forget this passphrase, nobody can read the cloud copy, not even you. The data on this device is not affected.
This device and the cloud both hold records. How should syncing start?
Keep everything. A record both sides have, such as an account with the same name and last 4 digits, is kept once.
Replace this device\'s records with the cloud\'s. A backup of them is saved in the app first.
They arrived before the records they belong to and are written once those arrive.
Could not reach the server. Sync retries when the device is online.
The server refused access. Sign out and sign in again.
Some records could not be decrypted: they were written with a different passphrase.
Some records come from a newer version of Cashiro. Update the app to read them.
Something went wrong. Try again later.
